explication: Hasura is a monorepo for a data API platform: V3 exposes GraphQL and JSON:API routes and documents support for multiple databases through Data Connectors and custom business-logic connectors; V2 includes a CLI and console metadata workflows. The graph preserves those distinct product stages and the sampled query-processing and metadata-migration layers. Several subsystems are represented by exact paths from the tree but were not sampled; their internal links are omitted unless the README or excerpts support them.
